title: Microsoft Edge: auto-open Copilot side pane for links opened from Outlook
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, policy paths, registry settings and documented defaults are supported. Two minor corrections should acknowledge Microsoft's conflicting statements about policy availability and cite the documentation for Copilot Chat in the Edge side pane.

claims.claim: The policy covers eligible web links from Outlook emails sent from the same tenant, not expressly external senders.
claims.quote: This policy controls whether Microsoft Edge automatically opens the Microsoft Copilot side pane when users open eligible web links from Outlook emails sent from the same tenant.

claims.claim: Copilot can use the originating email as context alongside destination web content in the side pane.
claims.quote: Copilot can use the originating Outlook email as context to surface relevant insights and suggested next steps alongside the web content.

claims.claim: The policy page marks the policy as not yet supported, so the briefing treats its behaviour as planned.
claims.quote: This policy is not yet supported. When support becomes available, eligible links from Outlook emails sent from the same tenant can open with the Copilot side pane.
claims.fix: After the not-yet-supported statement, add: 'Microsoft's Intune June 8, 2026 release notes describe this policy and automatic opening from Edge 148 in present terms, while the policy reference still says it is not yet supported and the roadmap remains In development.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/intune/whats-new/#week-of-june-8,-2026-service-release-2605.
